preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and all(c in '01' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input is a binary string consisting only of '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(stdout, str) and all(c in '01' for c in stdout) and len(stdout) == len(stdin)
postconditions.description: The output is a binary string of the same length as the input.

postconditions.expression: all(len(lis(s[l-1:r])) == len(lis(stdout[l-1:r])) for l in range(1, len(stdin)+1) for r in range(l, len(stdin)+1))
postconditions.description: For any substring of the input, the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence is equal to the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence of the corresponding substring of the output.

postconditions.expression: stdout.count('0') == sum(1 for i in range(len(stdin)) if all(lis(stdin[:i+1]) == lis(stdout[:i+1]) for i in range(i+1)))
postconditions.description: The number of zeroes in the output is maximized while maintaining the longest non-decreasing subsequence condition.
